title: 8 English Words With a Deeper Meaning | Overwhelmed, Compelling, Yeah Right!
text:
8 English words & expressions — and what they REALLY mean 👇

1. Overwhelmed — الضغط صار أكبر من طاقتك
2. Relieved — ارتحت بعد ما انزاح الهم
3. Compelling — مقنع لدرجة ما تقدر تتجاهله
4. Corroborate — يأكّد الشي بدليل إضافي
5. Conversely — وعلى العكس تمامًا
6. Yeah, right! — يعني: مستحيل أصدّقك
7. I don't buy it. — يعني: ما أصدّق هالكلام
8. That doesn't add up. — يعني: الكلام ما يركب على بعض

images.alt: Cover: Medical English — 8 disease names people translate wrong
'Chickenpox' — جدري الماء (العنقز). Example: My little brother caught chickenpox at school.
'Stroke' — سكتة دماغية. Example: Call an ambulance — he might be having a stroke.
'Dementia' — الخَرَف. Example: Dementia affects memory, thinking and daily life.
'Anaphylaxis' — صدمة تحسسية. Example: Peanuts can cause anaphylaxis in some people.
'Migraine' — صداع نصفي. Example: I can't look at the screen — I've got a migraine.
'Common cold' — زكام / نزلة برد. Example: Don't worry, it's just a common cold, not the flu.
'Heart failure' — قصور القلب. Example: Heart failure is a long-term condition, not a sudden event.
'Insomnia' — الأرق. Example: Too much coffee late at night can cause insomnia.
